items.title: Floating wetlands slash wastewater greenhouse gas emissions, according to study
items.summary: A world-first trial of floating wetland pods in wastewater lagoons shows they cut greenhouse gas emissions by more than a quarter, highlighting their potential as a nature-based solution for decarbonizing the water sector.
